senses.gloss: f. h. same, pot, contents of the pot, dish.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 8:3">Ḥull. VIII, 3</cite> <he>אם יש … באותה ק׳</he> if there is enough milk to give a taste to the entire contents of the pot.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 67b:7">Ab. Zar. 67ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ק׳ בת יומא</he>, v. <cite ref="J00195"><he>יוֹמָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:12">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 11a:11">Sot. 11ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 18:11">Ex. XVIII, 11</cite>) <he>בק׳ שבישלו</he>, v. <cite ref="B01359"><he>בָּשַׁל</he></cite>.

Ib. מאי משמע דהאי זדו לישנא דק׳ הוא what is your evidence that this zadu (Ex. l. c.) has the meaning of cooking in the pot? Pes. 112ᵃ לא תבשל בק׳ וכ׳ cook not in a pot which thy neighbor has used, i.e. marry not a divorced woman.
Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26ᵃ בשל … השחירה הקדרה וכ׳ when the semen within begins to boil, the pot blackens without (the hair grows); a. fr.—Trnsf. skull.

<cite ref="Chullin 45a:15">Ib.</cite>, sq. <he>כמין שני … על פי הק׳</he> two bean-like glands lie at the mouth of the skull (at the end of the cerebellum).—Pl. <cite ref="S00185"><he>קְדֵרוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00131"><he>קְדֵי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 30a:4">Pes. 30ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 95b:12">Zeb. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ בפסח ישברו</he> earthen pots in which leavened matter has been cooked on Passover, must be broken.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:1">Num. R. s. 16</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="S00173"><he>קַדָּר</he></cite>; a. fr.
